title: Adjudicate rule255 RX decode semantics: byte-preserving vs UDP source validation
description: Worker1 left two contradictory test artifacts from the rule255 TX/RX split work. (1) test_headers.py::test_validate_full_ipv6_structure_precedes_address_checks PINS: decode of mcast-src + corrupt-checksum raises "malformed source" (UDP source validation fires on decode). (2) schc_adaptation.json vectors 62/63/64 (rule255_rx_byte_preserving_unspecified_source/multicast_source/unspecified_destination) REQUIRE: decode of invalid-source/dest packets with VALID checksums SUCCEEDS byte-preserving ("decode succeeds even though a canonical sender could not have originated it"). The UDP parser (UdpDatagram.from_bytes) rejects invalid sources unconditionally after zero-checksum check, so (1) and (2) cannot both hold. Resolution needed from worker6-29bu author or Mark: either the vectors expect_error slugs are wrong (should be structural messages), or the UDP source check must move behind a TX-only gate (which would break pinned test (1) for corrupt-checksum cases). Current state: emission helper widened (unspecified/multicast TX rejection in encode_rule255 — all emission_rejects tests pass); 3 vector tests fail pending adjudication. Affects: python/tests/schc/test_headers.py, python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py, test/vectors/schc_adaptation.json.
